scope: Post-hoc diagnosis of all3saved proposals, not a new closed-loop policy comparison
ordinary_rule: Exact unchanged floor pose rejects immediately; otherwise execute one proposal in an isolated original-native clone and compare unchanged checker outputs with the actual before state. Reject newly intersecting furniture or new missing objects/out-of-bounds. A rejected proposal does not modify the committed original.
memory_control: Run pinned author memory update/renderer and build_messages functions on actual before-states and tool feedback; keep raw original evidence and same restricted system/images. No model inference and no extra teacher labels.
cannot_claim: Prevented harm in a newly executed model policy
Novel learning algorithm or complete generation success
